description.zh:
区域封禁（针对域名）的开关状态。使用JSON结构体转化的字符串表示，JSON结构体包含以下参数：
- **RegionblockEnable**：Integer类型，必选，区域封禁（针对域名）的开关状态。取值：
    - **1**：表示开启。
    - **0**：表示关闭。
description.en:
The status of the Location Blacklist feature (for domain names). This parameter is a string that is converted from a JSON struct. The JSON struct contains the following parameter:

- **RegionblockEnable**: An Integer value that is required. The status of the Location Blacklist feature (for domain names). Valid values:

  - **1**: enables the feature.

  - **0**: disables the feature.

description.zh:
要设置区域封禁功能的域名。

> 您可以调用[DescribeDomains](~~91724~~)查询所有已接入DDoS高防防护的域名。
description.en:
The domain name for which you want to set the Location Blacklist feature.

> You can call [DescribeDomains](~~91724~~) to query all domain names that are protected by Anti-DDoS Proxy.

description.zh:
DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组。
description.en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Proxy instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not set this parameter, the default resource group is used.

title.zh: 设置网站业务区域封禁开关状态

descriptions.zh:
本接口用于设置网站业务区域封禁（针对域名）的开关状态。

### QPS限制

本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用将会被限流，这可能影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
This operation sets the status of the Location Blacklist feature for website services (for domain names).

### QPS limits

The single-user queries per second (QPS) limit for this operation is 10. API calls that exceed the limit are throttled, which may affect your business. We recommend that you call this operation at an appropriate rate.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo modify-web-area-block-switch --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --domain www.aliyundoc.com --config RegionblockEnable_:_1 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
